verdict.rationale: Datalab's Marker-based conversion targets Markdown/HTML/JSON output (docs-1, docs-17, docs-22), which implicitly encodes headings and structure, and document segmentation features (docs-5, docs-20) suggest some structural awareness, but no evidence explicitly discusses heading-level detection, reading-order preservation, or hierarchy fidelity as a named capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy extraction, reading-order handling for multi-column layouts, and independent benchmarking of structural fidelity beyond markdown formatting.
